content.text:
**Repaired finding submitted — LD: deviation (fallback).**

How each verifier defect was cured in operative language, in a single insertion (new Section 14.2.11):

1. **"Only an early-termination fee"** — the clause now expressly deems each Development Cost-based amount under Sections 14.2.1–14.2.10 a "liquidated amount ... including ... any such amount expressed as consideration for purchasing the Trial Data Package," closing the purchase-price escape route, and makes it "payable solely as a single early-termination fee."
2. **Computable three-month cap** — replaced the uncomputable "three months of Development Costs" with "not exceeding three (3) times the average monthly Development Costs paid or incurred during the twelve (12) months preceding the effective date of termination," using the only recurring cost run-rate the Agreement defines.
3. **Sole liquidated amount** — the retained formulas are no longer merely overridden "to the contrary"; each is expressly "superseded by this Section 14.2.11," and the fee is stated as "the sole liquidated amount payable by PB under this Agreement," eliminating the contradiction with 14.2.1–14.2.10.

Intent preservation: the supersession is scoped to Development Cost-based amounts only, so Approval Payments, Buy-Out Payments, the Trial Data Package assignment and every other commercial term in those subsections remain verbatim; nothing is deleted. 14.2.1's mutual right to pursue unliquidated damages at law is deliberately untouched — it is not a liquidated amount, falls outside this checklist, and benefits PB when PB is the non-breaching party.
